items.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
items.content_text: Google DeepMind unveiled the Gemini 2.5 robotic model, integrating vision, language, and motion control to operate diverse hardware like Apptronik robots. In pilot tests at Mercedes-Benz plants, the model achieved a 96% success rate and increased task speed by up to 30%.

items.title: Dreeze, launched by Zerto founders to help companies recover from cyberattacks by restoring entire cloud applications, emerges from stealth with a $33M seed (CTech)
items.content_text: Founded by the Zerto team, Dreeze emerged from stealth with $33 million in seed funding. The company focuses on recovering entire cloud applications, including infrastructure and configurations, rather than just data, to ensure business continuity after cyberattacks.

items.title: Reddit launches Reddit Reviews, a built-in hub using AI to turn subreddit comments into product pages with pros, cons, and sentiment, starting with 10K items (Mia Sato/The Verge)

items.title: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 completes 41 percent of real freelance jobs, up from 2.5 percent a year ago
items.content_text: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 model has achieved a 41.3% success rate on the Remote Labor Index, completing professional freelance projects at a standard acceptable to paying clients. This represents a 16-fold increase in capability since the benchmark's inception a year ago, signaling a massive leap in agentic productivity.

items.title: Evolving metal extraction processes
items.content_text: The metals industry has experienced transformational moments before: the Bessemer process, flash smelting, electric arc furnaces, and modern continuous casting all changed what was possible. Yet, for more than a century, most extraction processes rely on techniques and pathways that would be familiar to metallurgists from generations ago. Processes have become larger and control systems smarter, but the fundamental science behind separating metals from ores has changed less than many realize.
